final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: diode sinks the 10uA reference
MB0 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=2.5 L=1 m=1
* tail current source 80uA
MT  tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=2.5 L=1 m=8
* NMOS input pair
M1  n1 vinn tail vss nfet W=16 L=1 m=1
M2  n2 vinp tail vss nfet W=16 L=1 m=1
* PMOS mirror load
M3  n1 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=16 L=1 m=1
M4  n2 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=16 L=1 m=1
* second stage: PMOS CS (9x M3 -> 360uA) + NMOS sink 360uA
M7  vout n2 vdd vdd pfet W=16 L=1 m=9
M8  vout ibias vss vss nfet W=2.5 L=1 m=36
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz  n2 nz 1k
Cc  nz vout 4p
.ends
